response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color AS product_color, SUM(i.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced_amount FROM Invoice_Line_Items i JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), stats AS (SELECT SUM(invoiced_amount) AS total_amount, AVG(invoiced_amount) AS avg_amount FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(c.invoiced_amount) AS avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(c.invoiced_amount * 1.0 / s.total_amount) AS avg_share, AVG(c.invoiced_amount - s.avg_amount) AS avg_above_per_color_average FROM color_totals c CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE c.invoiced_amount > s.avg_amount
